refund.title: Refund payment
refund.intro: Refunds run on your connected Stripe account and update this invoice's refund fields.
refund.fullExplanation: A <full>full</full> refund requests everything Stripe still allows on this charge (after any earlier partial refunds). That amount can differ from the invoice total in rare cases.
refund.offlineIntro: This invoice was marked paid outside Stripe. Each submission adds to the cumulative refund on the invoice (it does not move money in Stripe).
refund.offlineLimit: You can record up to {amount} more so total refunds do not exceed the invoice total.

settings.title: Invoice Settings
settings.selectCompany: Select a company to manage its invoice settings.
settings.noAccess: You need to be an Owner or Admin of a company to manage invoice settings.
settings.sendInvoiceSmsDescription: Also send an SMS when this company sends an invoice email. Uses your connected Quo or Twilio number, or Aquatechy’s number if none is connected. The client must have a phone number. SMS text is not customizable, and there is no per-client invoice SMS preference.
settings.sendEstimateSmsDescription: Also send an SMS when this company sends an estimate email. Uses your connected Quo or Twilio number, or Aquatechy’s number if none is connected. The client must have a phone number. SMS text is not customizable, and there is no per-client estimate SMS preference.
settings.invoiceViewOnly: Only owners and admins can update invoice communication settings for this company.
settings.estimateViewOnly: Only owners and admins can update estimate email templates for this company.
settings.variablesHelp: You can use the following variables in your email templates:
settings.estimateTemplatesHelp: Customize emails sent when estimates are shared with clients and when your company is notified of accept/decline events. Placeholders are replaced when emails are sent.
settings.clientEstimateEmailHelp: Sent to the client when you send an estimate. Accept/decline buttons, PDF attachment, and portal link are always included by the system.
settings.acceptanceNotificationHelp: Sent to your company reply-to email (or company email) when a client or staff member accepts an estimate.
settings.declineNotificationHelp: Sent to your company reply-to email (or company email) when a client or staff member declines an estimate.
